instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/task-039_initial.scad and /home/user/Desktop/task-039_motor.stl in OpenSCAD. Modify /home/user/Desktop/task-039_initial.scad. Use difference() between guard_blank() and the imported motor shape /home/user/Desktop/task-039_motor.stl to create a protective cover that fits around the motor. The target 2.5 mm thickness applies to the X- and Y-direction side walls; retain the imported motor's given Z placement, which leaves the bottom and top clearances determined by that seed geometry. Add six diameter 3 mm ventilation holes through the Y-direction side walls, with hole centers at x=-24, -14, -4, 6, 16, and 26 mm and z=20 mm. Export /home/user/Desktop/task-039_output.stl. [Software] To use OpenSCAD, run `openscad` from a terminal. On this machine, run OpenSCAD from `/usr/bin/openscad` when working on `task-039_initial.scad`.
